quest.title: Orobashi's Legacy: Part V
quest.description: The ancient ruins of what is now called Fort Mumei rises slowly from beneath the waves. Amidst the cries of whales and waves, you can hear a hidden, ancient grudge...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x450, Primogem x50, Diagram: Kitain Cross Spear x1, Hero's Wit x6, Mora x60000

dialogues.speaker: Kaji
dialogues.text: Thanks for your efforts. Although the island is still full of dangers, this will give a little hope to all the people who have left their hometown and long to return.

dialogues.speaker: Kaji
dialogues.text: The fact that the rain has stopped may actually make the warring parties more aggressive in fighting for the island...

dialogues.speaker: Kaji
dialogues.text: But they were never going to help resolve the situation on the island anyway. What we have done is at least better than leaving the problem to fester.

dialogues.speaker: Kaji
dialogues.text: Now, the gift I promised you.

dialogues.speaker: Kaji
dialogues.text: This is the famed spear once used by the Prefects of Yashiori. Now, I'm not sure how much use this drawing will be to you...

dialogues.speaker: Kaji
dialogues.text: But if you give it to a sufficiently skilled smith, they should be able to recreate the glory it once had in Lord Kitain's hands.

dialogues.speaker: Kaji
dialogues.text: *sigh* Alas, the age of heroes has come and gone, and the Kitain, who once destroyed so many evils, will never return again.

dialogues.speaker: Kaji
dialogues.text: Still, we seem to have gotten a step closer to matching Lord Kitain's deeds in the present, thanks to your help.

dialogues.speaker: Kaji
dialogues.text: Next, I will go to my friends in the Shogunate army to see if there's anything I can help with. I hope to see you again in the future.

dialogues.speaker: Place
dialogues.text: It seems that two critical components are missing from the ward.
